item.title: Madlanga Commission | Evidence links R3.7 million tender to Matlala’s wife

item.title: Construction site shut down after 50 undocumented workers arrested in Ekurhuleni blitz
item.description: A construction site in Clayville, Ekurhuleni has been shut down with immediate effect after a high-impact government operation uncovered a fraudulent permit, widespread labour law violations and the arrest of more than 50 suspected undocumented foreign nationals.
